protocol.task_standardisation: per-task z-score with Train-session1 statistics computed over all Train rows of that task, applied to Train and Test
protocol.threshold: quantile 1-a of the 5-block Train OOF score distribution
protocol.loso: for each held identity: enrolled = other 19, prototypes only from pm & fit_rows, scored block 0.6<frac<=0.8
protocol.test: scored once, never used for fitting or threshold selection
protocol.session: used only for the descriptive diagnostic AUC / S1 / S2 audit

transforms.raw: identity (cached E65 correlation-logSPD, Train BrainPrint_cache/e65_correlation_spd/train_correlation_logspd.npy, Test research/E121_pca_sweep/test_logspd.npy)
transforms.car: common average reference: x - mean(x over the 18 channels), per trial
transforms.car_rank: CAR, then per-channel rank transform to normal quantiles over the 1200 time samples of the same trial: sqrt(2)*erfinv(2*(rank+0.5)/1200 - 1)
transforms.laplacian: x_i - mean(x_j for j in the fixed 10-20 nearest-neighbour set of channel i); fixed adjacency, no data-driven neighbour search
transforms.bipolar: 18 fixed bipolar derivations (anterior-posterior / temporal chains + midline + O1-O2), see bipolar_pairs
transforms.car_plus_slope: CAR E65 correlation-logSPD (855) concatenated with the cached E186 aperiodic 1/f slope features (18, layout 72:90), each block RMS-normalised on Train fit rows
